name: dongle
description: Connecting the Quest 3 directly with ethernet

blocks.text: **__Using a USB Dongle/Adapter on your Meta Quest__**

While it's technically **unsupported by Meta**, it is possible to use a USB to Ethernet adapter or hub attached to your Quest 3 headset.

**Steps:**
* Disable Wifi on your headset.
* Unplug your headset.
* Turn off your headset.
* Connect your Ethernet to USB adapter to your headset.
* Plug an Ethernet cable into your Ethernet to USB adapter and plug the other end into your router, hub, switch or PC (Must set up ICS for connecting directly to the PC with Ethernet. Type `/ics` in the channel for more information)
* Power on your headset.
* Open Virtual Desktop and connect to your PC.

**A few important points to know:**
1. This is a not officially supported feature and can be removed by Meta at any time. (Meta removed this feature from the Quest 2 and the Quest 3 in the past and later restored it)
2. Many USB to Ethernet devices simply will not work. You'll need to research which ones will work. (Lot's of documented working adapters listed here: https://discord.com/channels/564087419918483486/1390686127937159209 )
3. The headset will give you no indication that it's using the Ethernet connection other than that it simply works.
4. **Meta will not provide support for this feature. **
